cloud_contract: FlightCore Cloud 4.4.0-cloud-ui.6 remains compatible; no Cloud deployment is required for RC24.
controlled_parent: Exact accepted and Recovery-V5-verified FlightCore 4.4.0-rc.19 build 20260903.133254-590c4c2.
failed_candidates: RC20 failed installation; RC21 was preflight-blocked; RC22 failed its local macOS publication gate; RC23 was published but its delivered preflight rejected its valid checksum before SSH. None is an authorized source.
hotfix_state: No mutable hotfix. RC24 is a new immutable corrective candidate.
logging: The passive RC20 logging scope is retained without changes to flight-control or transmission timing.
operator_workflow: Publish, independently verify, run the RC19-to-RC24 read-only preflight, then use the FlightCore Software Update page.
public_bootstrap: Self-contained RC24 bootstrap; no companion shell helper is required.
registry_gate: Only the exact accepted RC19 controlled parent is authorized for upgrade. RC20, RC21, RC22 and RC23 are explicitly rejected.
rollback_integrity: Canonical release-tree snapshots and restores use one checksummed helper and fail closed on missing, altered, or unverifiable recovery material.
operator_preflight_checksum: The exact delivered validator compares the checksum filename with the archive named by this manifest and is tested with valid and deliberately invalid inputs.
xattr_portability: Native Python extended-attribute reads where available; macOS xattr name/value fallback; unavailable backends fail closed.
